servinfo.title: Rear Side-Impact G Sensor Removal and Installation

attention1.ptxt: Failure to take proper precautions when handling the air bag system sensors can result in personal injury due to non-deployed air bag system in the event of an accident or accidental air bag deployment.

item.ptxt: Never impact or shake the sensors. Otherwise, proper operation of the sensors cannot be assured.
Always tighten the mounting bolts to specified torque when installing the sensors. Otherwise, proper operation of the sensors cannot be assured.

s1.ptxt: Remove rear quarter inner lower trim.
Disconnect rear side-impact G sensor connector (2) as follows.

s2.ptxt: Release locking slider (1) by sliding it in arrow direction “1”.
Disconnect rear side-impact G sensor connector by pulling it in arrow direction “2”.

s1.ptxt: Remove rear side-impact G sensor bolt (3) and remove rear side-impact G sensor (4) from rear door striker reinforcement (5).
Check that none of the following faulty conditions exists.

item.ptxt: Bend, deformation or rust on rear door striker reinforcement

s1.ptxt: Align mounting pin (1) to mounting hole (2) of vehicle to install rear side-impact G sensor (3) securely.
Tighten rear side-impact G sensor bolt to specified torque.
Connect rear side-impact G sensor connector securely.
Install rear quarter inner lower trim.
